status: verified research prototypes, not production cutover

verification.note: Combined gate passed ten files; realm had a code/check_old_code API typo. Corrected to erlang/check_old_code; final realm gate passed. Counts below are collectively verified, not a claim that the original combined command exited zero.

dependencies.scope: Closed generated column projection and declared dependency model. No automatic arbitrary-function tracing or production socket integration. Cross-store composition is not implemented by the single-store adapter.

bounded.scope: General multikey ranking still materializes/sorts matching postings. Native bounded pages require maintained single-term rank order and PageScan; nonpaged bounded requests use Count admission/refusal. Rank maintenance beyond the fixture is not a production subsystem. Row counters do not prove total CPU/byte/history bounds.

lookup.decision: Reject the extra research cache layer as a performance implementation; optimize the existing authoritative Env/kernel mechanism instead.
lookup.scope: Finite transition proof and runtime parity for tested epoch-aware mutations. Complete mutation coverage is NOT established; the negative control disproves the blanket stamp axiom for the exposed low-level helper.

negative_controls: pure but partial strict boolean BIFs
consumer.scope: Closed literal/range source and stable total predicate research adapter. Uses existing system.ir/footprint and lowering APIs; central optimizer currently has no first-filter law. Callee resolution is declared in the adapter, not a production proof certificate. No native allocation/cell-count reduction was separately measured.

negative_controls: two owners of one live segment
realm.scope: Real descriptor-to-BEAM/cache/init adapter, sequential and no hot reload. Production loader, full namespace compilation, arbitrary macro effects, actor races, shared-segment leasing and cross-realm relocation are not implemented.

proof_scope: Finite exhaustive veritas domains and explicit SMT obligations plus real runtime differential/counter tests. Model truths are not universal production certificates. Unknown/refused/incomplete cases remain explicit.
wall_time_comparison: Not used for performance conclusions; host memory pressure and swap varied greatly.
